q_site.name: Adsorption metal charge
q_site.description: Signed Bader charge on the adsorption metal; positive means electron deficiency.

q_partner.name: Partner metal charge
q_partner.description: Signed Bader charge on the other metal.

metal_metal_distance_A.name: Metal separation
metal_metal_distance_A.description: Cartesian separation between the two metals.

site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_mean.name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand dipole magnitude
site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_mean.description: Mean of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_std_.name: Adsorption metal: spread ligand dipole magnitude
site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_std_.description: Spread of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_min_.name: Adsorption metal: minimum ligand dipole magnitude
site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_min_.description: Minimum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_max_.name: Adsorption metal: maximum ligand dipole magnitude
site_heteroatom_dipole_contribution_max_.description: Maximum of individual point-charge contribution magnitudes on the selected N/O/S neighbors; spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_charge_dipole_proxy_norm.name: Adsorption metal: net ligand dipole magnitude

site_heteroatom_charge_sum_e.name: Adsorption metal: total ligand charge
site_heteroatom_charge_sum_e.description: Total of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_charge_mean_e.name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand charge

site_heteroatom_charge_min_e.name: Adsorption metal: minimum ligand charge

site_heteroatom_charge_max_e.name: Adsorption metal: maximum ligand charge
site_heteroatom_charge_max_e.description: Maximum of signed Bader charges on the selected N/O/S neighbors; minimum is the most negative charge and spread is population standard deviation.

site_heteroatom_spin_abs_mean_muB.name: Adsorption metal: mean ligand spin magnitude

site_angle_mean_deg.name: Mean ligand angle at adsorption metal
site_angle_mean_deg.description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

site_angle_std_deg.name: Spread of ligand angle at adsorption metal
site_angle_std_deg.description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

site_angle_min_deg.name: Smallest ligand angle at adsorption metal
site_angle_min_deg.description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

site_angle_max_deg.name: Largest ligand angle at adsorption metal
site_angle_max_deg.description: Summary of all distinct ligand-metal-ligand angles at the adsorption metal; each neighbor pair has equal weight.

shared_bridge_angle_mean_deg.name: Mean metal-bridge-metal angle
shared_bridge_angle_mean_deg.description: Mean angle at each shared ligand between vectors pointing to the two metals.

shared_bridge_angle_std_deg.name: Spread of metal-bridge-metal angles
shared_bridge_angle_std_deg.description: Population standard deviation of the angles at shared bridging ligands.

shared_bridge_dipole_contribution_asymme.name: Mean bridge dipole magnitude asymmetry
shared_bridge_dipole_contribution_asymme.description: Mean absolute difference between a shared ligand's charge-moment magnitudes about the two metals.

spin_site_abs.name: Adsorption metal spin magnitude
spin_site_abs.description: Absolute calculated atomic magnetic moment of the adsorption metal.

spin_partner_abs.name: Partner metal spin magnitude
spin_partner_abs.description: Absolute calculated atomic magnetic moment of the other metal.

spin_product_muB2.name: Signed metal spin product
spin_product_muB2.description: Product of signed metal magnetic moments; opposite signs give a negative product.

support_net_spin_muB.name: Net support spin
support_net_spin_muB.description: Signed sum of magnetic moments over every atom except the two metals, including carbon and hydrogen.

support_abs_spin_sum_muB.name: Total support spin magnitude
support_abs_spin_sum_muB.description: Sum of absolute magnetic moments over every atom except the two metals.

ligand_plane_rms_A.name: Ligand nonplanarity
ligand_plane_rms_A.description: RMS perpendicular ligand displacement from the best-fit plane; requires at least three selected ligands.

metal_height_above_ligand_plane_A.name: Metal displacement from ligand plane
metal_height_above_ligand_plane_A.description: Absolute distance of adsorption metal from the best-fit ligand plane.

shared_ligand_count.name: Shared ligand count
shared_ligand_count.description: Number of N/O/S ligands within 2.30 Angstrom of both metals.

terminal_ligand_count.name: Terminal ligand count
terminal_ligand_count.description: Number of selected adsorption-metal ligands that do not neighbor the partner metal.

site_shared_ligand_charge_mean_e.name: Adsorption metal: mean shared ligand charge
site_shared_ligand_charge_mean_e.description: Mean signed Bader charge of shared ligands in this metal's shell.

site_terminal_ligand_charge_mean_e.name: Adsorption metal: mean terminal ligand charge
site_terminal_ligand_charge_mean_e.description: Mean signed Bader charge of terminal ligands in this metal's shell.

partner_shared_ligand_charge_mean_e.name: Partner metal: mean shared ligand charge
partner_shared_ligand_charge_mean_e.description: Mean signed Bader charge of shared ligands in this metal's shell.

partner_terminal_ligand_charge_mean_e.name: Partner metal: mean terminal ligand charge
partner_terminal_ligand_charge_mean_e.description: Mean signed Bader charge of terminal ligands in this metal's shell.

second_shell_C_2.8A.name: Second-shell carbon density near 2.8 Angstrom
second_shell_C_2.8A.description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

second_shell_C_3.6A.name: Second-shell carbon density near 3.6 Angstrom
second_shell_C_3.6A.description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

second_shell_heteroatom_2.8A.name: Second-shell N/O/S density near 2.8 Angstrom
second_shell_heteroatom_2.8A.description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

second_shell_heteroatom_3.6A.name: Second-shell N/O/S density near 3.6 Angstrom
second_shell_heteroatom_3.6A.description: Sum over the specified support atoms farther than 2.30 Angstrom from the adsorption metal; both metals excluded.

partner_angle_mean_deg.name: Mean ligand angle at partner metal
partner_angle_mean_deg.description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

partner_angle_std_deg.name: Spread of ligand angle at partner metal
partner_angle_std_deg.description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

partner_angle_min_deg.name: Smallest ligand angle at partner metal
partner_angle_min_deg.description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

partner_angle_max_deg.name: Largest ligand angle at partner metal
partner_angle_max_deg.description: Summary over all unique selected ligand pairs, with the partner metal as the angle vertex.

metal_pair_net_spin_abs_muB.name: Net metal-pair magnetic moment magnitude
metal_pair_net_spin_abs_muB.description: Magnitude of the sum of the two signed local metal moments.

metal_pair_spin_imbalance_muB.name: Metal magnetic moment imbalance
metal_pair_spin_imbalance_muB.description: Difference between the magnitudes of the two local metal moments.

total_clean_magnetic_moment_abs_muB.name: Total clean-structure magnetic moment magnitude
total_clean_magnetic_moment_abs_muB.description: Absolute stored post_opt_rpbe_d4_total_magmom; a whole-system DFT quantity, not a sum asserted equal to partitioned atomic moments.

site_support_spin_product_muB2.name: Adsorption metal–support spin product
site_support_spin_product_muB2.description: Signed alignment proxy for the metal and the remaining clean support; not an exchange energy.

metal_pair_charge_dipole_axis_eA.name: Metal-pair axial charge dipole
metal_pair_charge_dipole_axis_eA.description: Metal-only Bader-charge moment about the metal midpoint, projected toward the adsorption metal.

site_heteroatom_net_spin_abs_mean_muB.name: Adsorption-site net ligand magnetic moment per atom
site_heteroatom_net_spin_abs_mean_muB.description: Cancellation-aware magnitude of the signed mean ligand moment.

site_metal_ligand_spin_product_muB2.name: Adsorption-site metal–ligand spin product
site_metal_ligand_spin_product_muB2.description: Signed collinear metal–ligand alignment proxy; not an exchange energy.

site_heteroatom_dipole_axis_eA.name: Adsorption-site axial ligand charge dipole
site_heteroatom_dipole_axis_eA.description: Signed ligand Bader-charge moment projected along the metal-pair axis away from the other metal.

site_heteroatom_dipole_transverse_eA.name: Adsorption-site transverse ligand charge dipole
site_heteroatom_dipole_transverse_eA.description: Magnitude of the ligand charge moment perpendicular to the metal-pair axis.

site_ligand_quadrupole_norm_eA2.name: Adsorption-site ligand charge quadrupole magnitude
site_ligand_quadrupole_norm_eA2.description: Frobenius norm of the traceless Bader-charge quadrupole tensor about this metal.

site_ligand_quadrupole_axis_eA2.name: Adsorption-site axial ligand charge quadrupole
site_ligand_quadrupole_axis_eA2.description: Quadrupole tensor projected along the metal-pair axis.

partner_heteroatom_net_spin_abs_mean_muB.name: Partner-site net ligand magnetic moment per atom
partner_heteroatom_net_spin_abs_mean_muB.description: Cancellation-aware magnitude of the signed mean ligand moment.

partner_metal_ligand_spin_product_muB2.name: Partner-site metal–ligand spin product
partner_metal_ligand_spin_product_muB2.description: Signed collinear metal–ligand alignment proxy; not an exchange energy.

partner_heteroatom_dipole_axis_eA.name: Partner-site axial ligand charge dipole
partner_heteroatom_dipole_axis_eA.description: Signed ligand Bader-charge moment projected along the metal-pair axis away from the other metal.

partner_heteroatom_dipole_transverse_eA.name: Partner-site transverse ligand charge dipole
partner_heteroatom_dipole_transverse_eA.description: Magnitude of the ligand charge moment perpendicular to the metal-pair axis.

partner_ligand_quadrupole_norm_eA2.name: Partner-site ligand charge quadrupole magnitude
partner_ligand_quadrupole_norm_eA2.description: Frobenius norm of the traceless Bader-charge quadrupole tensor about this metal.

partner_ligand_quadrupole_axis_eA2.name: Partner-site axial ligand charge quadrupole
partner_ligand_quadrupole_axis_eA2.description: Quadrupole tensor projected along the metal-pair axis.

site_bader_electron_population.name: Adsorption metal Bader electron population
site_bader_electron_population.description: Stored DFT Bader electron population from data.bader_electrons, including the core convention of the source calculation.

site_ligand_bader_electron_mean.name: Adsorption metal mean ligand Bader electron population
site_ligand_bader_electron_mean.description: Mean stored Bader electron population of selected N/O/S ligands.

partner_bader_electron_population.name: Partner metal Bader electron population
partner_bader_electron_population.description: Stored DFT Bader electron population from data.bader_electrons, including the core convention of the source calculation.

partner_ligand_bader_electron_mean.description: Mean stored Bader electron population of selected N/O/S ligands.
